systems.platform: Tier III data centre, 1,372 m2, 100 racks; in-country cloud hosting, backup and disaster recovery services
systems.owner: Government of Mauritania (Ministry of Digital Transformation); financed by the EIB
systems.tiers: national; public administrations, financial institutions, startups and service providers

note: Reports the data centre opened 2025-05-08 as the result of an unnamed 'ambitious policy'; names no hosting or cloud policy and no requirement that public bodies host there, so no fact of class policy.
